item.title: Education ministry and Qatar Charity launch sustainable education initiative
item.description:
The Ministry of Education and Higher Education and Qatar Charity launched the "Takamul for Sustainable Education" initiative to support students from low-income families in private schools and kindergartens. The initiative provides educational aids and school supplies and promotes volunteering and social responsibility at school. The launch was attended by Minister Lolwah bint Rashid Al Khater and Qatar Charity CEO Yousef bin Ahmed Al Kuwari.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/ministry-of-education-and-higher-education-qatar-charity-launch-sustainable-education-initiative · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D9%85%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B9%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B5%D8%A9

item.title: Qatar Central Bank extends Himyan card acceptance to Oman
item.description:
Qatar Central Bank announced the gradual acceptance of the national payment card Himyan in Oman, allowing holders to make purchases and cash withdrawals at supporting points of sale and ATMs. The expansion follows acceptance in Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Kuwait, under the Third Financial Sector Strategy and efforts to integrate Gulf payment systems.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/qcb-expands-himyan-card-acceptance-to-oman · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/26/11/2026/%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%B1%D9%81-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%B2%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%A8%D8%B7%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D9%87%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%B7%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86

item.title: WISH 8 brings health experts to Doha on 29 and 30 November
item.description:
Qatar Foundation holds the eighth World Innovation Summit for Health (WISH) at Qatar National Convention Centre on 29 and 30 November, in partnership with the Ministry of Public Health, under the theme "The New Health Span". The summit covers five pillars, including longevity, AI and the future of fertility, and launches four research reports. Harvard Medical School professor Dr David Sinclair delivers the opening keynote.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/qfs-wish8-to-put-future-of-global-health-at-centre-of-discussions-in-doha-on-nov-29-30 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D9%82%D9%85%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%82%D8%B4-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%AD%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9

item.title: Qatar reviews company and bankruptcy laws, regulates freelance and part-time work
item.description:
Officials at the Public-Private Sector Dialogue Forum said the Ministry of Commerce and Industry is reviewing company, bankruptcy and competition laws to improve the business environment and attract investment. Ministry of Labour Assistant Undersecretary Khamis Al Nuaimi said amendments regulated more flexible work patterns, including freelance and part-time work, and raised the maximum non-compete period from one year to two.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/qatar-steps-up-legislative-reforms-to-support-businesses-attract-investment · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/%D8%AE%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%85%D9%8A-%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%8A%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B1-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A6%D9%8A

item.title: Open fight for Formula 2 title at Lusail as leader Camara misses round
item.description:
The penultimate 13th round of the Formula 2 World Championship starts today, Friday, at Lusail International Circuit alongside the Qatar Formula 1 Grand Prix. Championship leader Rafael Camara of Brazil misses the Qatar and UAE rounds while racing for Haas in Formula 1. Bulgaria's Nikola Tsolov is second, 7 points behind, and needs a 39-point lead to clinch the title at Lusail.

item.title: Al Rayyan edge Kuwait's Burgan 31-30 at Gulf handball championship
item.description:
Al Rayyan beat Kuwait's Burgan 31-30 on Thursday evening in their final preliminary-round match of the 42nd Gulf Cup Winners' Cup handball championship in Bahrain. Al Rayyan moved to 6 points from two wins and two draws and await other results to confirm qualification. Defending champions Al Arabi face Kuwait SC today in a decisive match for a semi-final place.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D8%B8%D9%88%D8%B8%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/26/11/2026/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%B7%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8042-%D9%84%D9%83%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D9%8A%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B2-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AA%D9%8A-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B9%D8%B2%D8%B2-%D8%AD%D8%B8%D9%88%D8%B8%D9%87-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%A3%D9%87%D9%84

item.title: Aspire Zone launches K7 Khalifa Challenge with QR140,000 prize pool in January
item.description:
Aspire Zone Foundation announced the first K7 Khalifa Challenge, combining running and functional fitness, on 29 and 30 January 2027 around Khalifa International Stadium. The competition features seven rounds with 700-metre runs and a QR140,000 prize pool, open to those aged 16 and above. Erada Fitness is the technical partner.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/azf-to-launch-inaugural-k7-khalifa-challenge-in-january · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%B2%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D9%84%D9%82-%D8%A8%D8%B7%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D9%81%D8%A9-k7

item.title: Erdogan ratifies Makkah joint defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan
item.description:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan today, Friday, ratified the Makkah joint defence agreement with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, according to the Turkish official gazette, completing Ankara's ratification after parliament approved it on 5 November. The pact treats an attack on one party as an attack on all three. The three countries meet in Islamabad on Friday and Saturday.
Sources: Arab News https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/erdogan-completes-ratification-process-for-the-makkah-agreement-on-joint-defense-3014220 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/uae-residents-update-us-iran-tensions-kuwait-attack-saudi-refinery-strike-and-flight-disruptions-1.500762882

item.title: Coalition intercepts Houthi drone launched towards southern Saudi Arabia
item.description:
Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki Al Maliki announced the interception and destruction of a drone launched by the Houthis towards Saudi Arabia's southern region. The announcement follows a projectile attack on the Jazan refinery that killed a Nepali worker, to which the coalition responded with an operation against the group's capabilities.
Sources: Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%A3%D8%B7%D9%84%D9%82%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%A7-%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%87-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-1 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7633920

item.title: Oman condemns attacks on Kuwait and calls for an end to escalation
item.description:
Oman's Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned in a statement today, Friday, the attacks on Kuwait, affirming the Sultanate's full solidarity and rejecting any infringement on Kuwait's sovereignty, security and stability. Muscat renewed its call for an immediate end to all military escalation in the region and for dialogue and diplomatic channels to safeguard regional peace and security.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/oman-condemns-attacks-against-kuwait · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%B7%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%AA

item.title: Etihad extends cancellation of Riyadh and Dammam flights to 31 December
item.description:
Etihad Airways extended the cancellation of all passenger and cargo flights between Abu Dhabi and Riyadh and Dammam until Thursday, 31 December 2026, after the suspension had been set to end on 30 November. Jeddah and other Saudi flights continue as scheduled, while the airline warned of further changes as the situation remains fluid.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/aviation/etihad-cancels-abu-dhabi-flights-to-dammam-and-riyadh-until-december-31-1.500762958 · Al Bayan https://www.albayan.ae/economy/business/uae-economy/1567990

item.title: UAE issues first digital dirham treasury bonds worth Dh180 million
item.description:
The UAE Ministry of Finance issued the first digital federal treasury bonds worth Dh180 million (about $49 million) through Euroclear's digital infrastructure, listed on Nasdaq Dubai. The bonds have a two-year tenor with an annual yield to maturity of 4.98%. Minister of State for Financial Affairs Mohamed Al Hussaini called the issuance an important milestone in developing the domestic debt market.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/markets/2026/11/27/uae-issues-first-dirham-denominated-digital-sovereign-treasury-bonds/ · Sada El Balad https://www.elbalad.news/7196318

item.title: Egypt's mosques hold funeral prayer in absentia for Warraq victims
item.description:
Ministry of Awqaf mosques and Al-Azhar Mosque held funeral prayers in absentia today, Friday, after Friday prayers for the victims of the Warraq Ring Road accident. The prayers followed directives from the Grand Imam of Al-Azhar Ahmed El-Tayeb and Awqaf Minister Osama Al-Azhari, who changed the sermon to focus on solidarity and compassion in times of crisis.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085234/x · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7633914

item.title: Social solidarity minister to name Warraq donors at news conference
item.description:
Social Solidarity Minister Maya Morsy announced a news conference to name all contributors supporting the families of the Warraq accident victims and the injured. She said it would detail, by name, what each beneficiary would receive, including victims, the injured and those who lost property, in line with transparency towards the public.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536698 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7633978

item.title: Cairo University allocates EGP1 billion to upgrade Kasr Al Ainy hospitals
item.description:
Cairo University's council, chaired by Dr Mohamed Samy Abdel Sadek, approved EGP1 billion to develop Kasr Al Ainy hospitals, including EGP400 million from the university's special funds and EGP200 million from the Ministry of Higher Education. The council also allocated 150 feddans in 6th of October City, south of the Wahat road, for an integrated new Kasr Al Ainy project.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536710 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7634029

item.title: 21-carat gold rises to about EGP5,650 on Friday morning
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt rose on Friday morning, with the most traded 21-carat at EGP5,645 to EGP5,655 according to market updates, against EGP5,630 at the start of trading. The 24-carat stood at EGP6,451 to EGP6,465 and the gold pound at EGP45,160 to EGP45,240, as the global ounce held steady.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536709 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_economy/details/2026/11/27/3085233/x

item.title: Met authority: mild weather and chances of light rain over Halayeb and Shalateen
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority forecast mild weather today, Friday, across most areas, hot in southern Upper Egypt and cool at night and early morning. It expected light rain with a 30% chance over Halayeb and Shalateen, and clouds over the north up to Greater Cairo and the Canal cities with a 10% chance of rain, urging caution in fog.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7634059 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085230/x

item.title: 1,350 trees delivered to North Sinai under 100 million trees initiative
item.description:
Local Development and Environment Minister Manal Awad announced the delivery of 1,350 trees to North Sinai governorate under the fifth phase of the presidential initiative to plant 100 million trees. The batch includes 675 tecoma and 675 jacaranda trees, 3 to 4 metres tall, to be planted in squares, schools, main roads and orphanages.
Sources: Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536697 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/27/x/7634015

item.title: Eisenkot strikes coalition deal with Golan's Democrats
item.description:
Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party and Yair Golan's Democrats announced on Thursday evening a coalition agreement, a further step towards a government to replace Benjamin Netanyahu's. The Democrats are the second party to reach a deal with Eisenkot after Israel Beiteinu on Tuesday and will receive four ministerial portfolios. Eisenkot has until 6 December to form a government, extendable by 14 days.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666570/world/eisenkot-and-golan-reach-coalition-deal-in-bid-to-replace-netanyahu · Yahoo News (dpa) https://www.yahoo.com/news/world/articles/israels-eisenkot-reaches-coalition-deal-161848794.html

item.title: Iraq closes two Kurdistan-run crossings with Syria and Iran
item.description:
Iraqi authorities closed the Al Waleed crossing with Syria and the Bashta crossing with Iran, previously run by the Kurdistan Regional Government, after a Federal Supreme Court ruling on Wednesday allowing federal forces on all international borders. Thousands protested in Erbil against Baghdad's moves on oil and border control, while the government denied reports of troop movements north.
Sources: Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666573/world/iraq-closes-unofficial-border-crossings-with-syria-and-iran-in-kurdish-region · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/27/iraqs-government-closes-two-border-crossing-with-iran-and-syria/

item.title: SAP weighs cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI restructuring
item.description:
German software company SAP is preparing a plan to cut at least 10,000 positions, more than 9% of its global workforce, to transform its business for the AI era, according to sources cited by Bloomberg. The final number has not been settled pending labour negotiations. Cuts are expected mainly in product, engineering and sales units, with an employment guarantee in Germany through 2028.
Sources: SiliconANGLE https://siliconangle.com/2026/11/26/sap-reportedly-plans-to-lay-off-10000-employees-amid-ai-push/ · BusinessWorld (Bloomberg) https://bworldonline.com/bloomberg/2026/11/27/797239/sap-weighs-cutting-at-least-10000-positions-in-ai-restructuring/

item.title: Russia extends jet fuel export ban to 31 March 2027
item.description:
The Russian government announced today, Friday, an extension of the jet fuel export ban until 31 March 2027, including volumes bought at exchange auctions, to keep the domestic market stable. The decree exempts supplies under intergovernmental agreements. Moscow imposes similar temporary curbs on other products, including diesel.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D8%B8%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%88%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B3-2027 · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D8%AD%D8%B8%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%88%D9%82%D9%88%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AD%D8%AA%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%B3-2027

item.title: Oil heads for first weekly gain in four weeks, Brent at $96.19
item.description:
Brent futures fell 38 cents to $96.19 a barrel in Asian trading today, Friday, after jumping about $2 on Thursday to the highest since 6 November. US crude rose 2.07% to $85.41 against Wednesday's settlement. Both benchmarks are heading for their first weekly gain in four weeks, amid attacks on tankers and energy facilities in Hormuz and Saudi Arabia.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/oil-heads-for-weekly-gains-despite-supply-concerns · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536723 · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/business/energy/2026/11/27/oil-set-to-post-weekly-gain-as-middle-east-attacks-stoke-supply-concerns/

item.title: Dollar steady near 22-month high, gold at $3,567
item.description:
The dollar index stood at 103.81 points today, Friday, ending a week in which it hit 104.53 on Monday, the highest since March last year, while the dollar rose 0.1% to 159.355 yen. Spot gold held at $3,567.33 an ounce, heading for a slight weekly gain, as markets await a possible US rate hike next month.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/27/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B1-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A3%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%87-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B0-22-%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7 · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%B1-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%A8-%D8%A3%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%87-%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B0-22-%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%B1%D8%A7 · Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/gold-trades-steady-as-investors-await-us-interest-rate-outlook · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536705
